accuracy_gates.denominator_policy: Every row exactly once; any non-success receives 100 mm adjudicated error.

candidate.implementation: Pack eight real left correlation fields into four complex forward FFTs and four Hermitian output spectra into two complex inverse FFTs; retain the same nine weighted correlation terms.
candidate.tree_hash_contract: SHA-256 over every non-target regular file below the named repository path, sorted by repository-relative path, with each UTF-8 path and byte payload prefixed by its unsigned eight-byte big-endian length

claim_boundary: This is an unopened analytic-synthetic seal. It contains no Flashalign result and makes no accuracy, latency, MRI, clinical, release, or cross-method claim.

construction.fixed_images: Six new independent analytic phantoms r07-r12, stored as float32 NIfTI on a 2 mm grid.
construction.independence: The v3 generator imports no Reframe4s code and did not execute Flashalign. Subject image parameters are distinct from the exposed v2 court; transform cohorts retain the sealed release ranges.
construction.interpolant_exact_rows: Moving voxels come from an independent standard-library trilinear sampler over stored fixed voxels at declared moving-to-fixed truth, then intensity = 80 + 1.17 * fixedSample.
construction.nonlinear_contrast_boundary: Signed-square-root intensity mapping; descriptive only and excluded from exact-recovery admission.

cost_evidence_requirement.ordinary_rows: exact-core rigid and affine, six rows each
cost_evidence_requirement.scope: read, decompression, preparation including fixed-spectrum preparation, capture, refinement, audit, and final output

execution_policy.next_step: Execute once, preserve all rows, and adjudicate accuracy and cost without tuning.
execution_policy.permitted_post_seal_changes: Evidence-integrity fixes only, with disclosed reseal and no candidate, fixture, transform, threshold, or adjudication change.

fixtures.input_binding: Every table row carries expected moving and fixed hashes; the runner rejects mismatch before execution.

preexecution_oracle.perturbations: plus/minus 0.1 mm translations and 0.3 degree target-frame rotations; affine rows also include plus/minus 0.5 percent axis scales

runner.candidate_mode: automatic public run only; explicit sealed descriptor and table identities
runner.output_stage: Materialize one linear FlashalignOutput from the original moving image on the fixed grid and charge its complete interval.
